description_en: Mū Guitaḥ Bahī, also known as Gustala Mahāvihāra, is located to the west of Cīdhã Bahī (Vasūccaśīla Mahāvihāra,LAL1970). The Bahī is attached to two other monastic complexes, Taḥdhã Bahī (Prathamaśrī Mahāvihāra,LAL1960) to the south and Cīdhã Bahī to the east. This Bahī is usually acccesed via seven stone steps to the north. A stone statue of Mahākāla is attached to a damaged wall on the right of the entrance door. One can also see the remnants of what was once the entry porch. This Bahī is located at a central position within the axis of the northernstūpaof Guitaḥ. The courtyard may also be accessed via the north western corner of the Cīdhã Bahī.The main sanctum of the monastic complex is housed on the ground floor of the southern wing. Inside the sanctum, one can find a statue of a standing Buddha made from stone (probably dating back to the 18th century) in abhaviṣyavyākaraṇaposture. This can be circumambulated using a narrow passage (70 cm in width). The front façade has a central carved door on its ground floor. The wall is whitewashed with lime, and the door is flanked by wall paintings of Sāriputra and Maudgalyāyana on either side. The monument building is attached to the wall of the eastern Cīdhã Bahī, whilst the rear southern wall acts as a boundary wall between it and the Taḥdhã Bahī. A small door leads from an open garden area at the south western corner of the courtyard to the southern Bahī. The two-storey monument building is in poor condition and is dilapidated. The colonnaded balcony on the first floor is missing a balustrade and has cracked masonry walls. Historical photos of the monastic building show that it was once roofed injhĩgaṭītiles, but nowadays its roof is covered in corrugated metal sheets. Monastic buildings are usually topped with aphucā,but there is none to be found in this case. Rather, the roof is topped with acaitya-shaped pinnacle. There is notoraṇaabove the entrance.The courtyard measures 12.2 m x 12.2 m and contains anaśoka caitya(135 cm in height), stone pillar (215 cm in height) and adharmadhātu maṇḍala(85 cm in height). These are all lined up centrally in front of the main sanctum building. Other stone slabs are also located on this on the axis, and the courtyard also contains specialnavagraha maṇḍala.Theguṭhīhouse of thebahīstands to the west of the god house and is also in a miserable condition. Aside from the god house and theguṭhīhouse, all other surrounding buildings are privately owned. The courtyard is full of vegetation and has been neglected. The western wing has a two-storey community building. This building was heavily damaged by the 2015 earthquake.This is the main and the oldest Bahī of the Guitaḥ Ṭola. An inscription dated to the Śaka Era (464 / CE 542) related to this Bahī was recently found in the Taḥdhã Bahī, suggesting that the history of this monastic building stretches back to the Licchavi period.
description_ne: लिच्छविकालमा गुल्लतङ्गग्राम नाम रहेको गुइत:टोलमा तीनवटा बही रहेका छन् । पहिले गुस्तल विहार भनी एउटा मात्र गुइत:बही थियो । पहिले त:धं गुइत:बही (प्रथमशील महाविहार LAL1960) छुट्टिएर गएपछि मूल गुइत:बही र त:धंबही भनी दुईवटा बही अस्तित्वमा आयो । कालान्तरमा फेरि मूल गुइत:बहीबाट टुक्रिएर चीधंबही (वसूच्चशील महाविहार, LAL1970) बन्यो (Vajrācārya1999, 41-42) । यसप्रकार एउटा मूल बहीबाट टुक्रिएर दुई नयाँ बही सहित गुइत: टोलमा तीनवटा बही अस्तित्वमा आए । तैपनि यी तीनवटै बहीहरू कुनै विहारको शाखा नभएर स्वतन्त्र बहीको रूपमा रहिआएका छन् । जुन मूल बहीबाट अरु दुईवटा बही छुट्टिएर गए त्यस बहीलाई नै मू गुइत:बही भन्न थालियो । स्थानीयहरू यस बहीलाईचिकंबहीचाभन्ने गर्छन् ।यो बहीभित्र पुग्न सात तहको खुड्किला चढ्नुपर्छ । बहीभित्र पस्ने मूल प्रवेशद्वार फलामले बनाइएको छ । मूल प्रवेशद्वारबाट भित्र छिरेपछि पश्चिमपट्टिको भित्तामा महाकाल स्थापना गरिएको छ । मूल प्रवेशद्वारको पूर्वमा पहिले फल्चा बनाइएको थियो । अहिले त्यहाँ कुनै फल्चा नभएपनि फल्चाको केही अवशेष देख्न सकिन्छ । मूल प्रवेशद्वारको ठीक सामुन्ने बहीको दुई तल्ले द्य:छेँ रहेको छ । निकै सामान्य देखिने द्य:छेँको छानामा पहिले झिंगटी राखिएको भपनि अहिले जस्तापाता राखिएको छ । बहीको छानामा पुल (फुचा) राख्ने परम्परा भएपनि यहाँ राखिएको छैन । पहिलो तलामा बहीको आगम राखिएको छ । आगमको बाहिर एउटातिकिझ्या:राखिएको छ । यस तलामा छानालाई अड्याउन चारवटा काठका खम्बा राखिएका छन् । तर बहीको भौतिक अवस्था नाजुक रहेकोले अहिले आगम देवतालाई अन्यत्रै सारिएको छ । भुइँतलामा बहीको गन्धुरी देवता राखिएको छ । गन्धकुटीभित्र पस्ने ढोका पनि साधारण किसिमले बनाइएको छ । ढोकामाथि कुनै तोरण राखिएको छैन । ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ शिलाङ्कुश र पिण्डपात्र धारण गरेका सारिपुत्र र मौदगल्यायनको चित्र लेखिएको छ । गन्धकुटीभित्र भविष्यव्याकरण मुद्रामा रहेको बुद्धलाई गन्धुरी देवताको रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । गन्धकुटीमा रहेको देवता परिक्रमा गर्न गन्धकुटीको वरिपरि साँघुरो प्रदक्षिणापथ बनाइएको छ । बहीको पहिलो तलालाई थाम्न राखिएका दुईवटा काठका खम्बामध्ये अहिले पश्चिमपट्टिको खम्बा मात्र बाँकी छ । यो बहीको भौतिक अवस्था एकदम नाजुक देखिन्छ । बही प्राङ्गणमा एउटा अशोक चैत्य, ढुंगाको स्तम्भ र धर्मधातु मण्डल स्थापना गरिएको छ । बहीको पश्चिममा रहेको गुठीघर पनि जीर्ण भइसकेको छ । द्य:छेँ र गुठीघर बाहेक अन्यत्र स्थानीय मानिसहरूको आवासीय घर रहेका छन् ।

historical_events.event_description: Thebahīcollapsed in the 1934 earthquake. Members ofsaṅghareconstructed it about four to five years later.

Harṣarāja and his family established twodharmadhātu maṇḍalasin two different places on the same date. One was established in Mū Guitaḥ Bahī and the other was established in the nearby Cīdhã Bahī (LAL1970). The inscription regarding the establishment of themaṇḍalais located in Cīdhã Bahī.
During the reign of King Ratna Malla, Jakharāja and his wife Māṇamayi Bhari donated funds for the installation of the Mahākāla image in memory of their son Vijayasiṃha Bhāro.
